# Marimo Studio 0.1.6

Marimo Studio 0.1.6 adds Observable Notebook Kit views, zero-Python
documentation exports, and Lens feedback across custom view layouts.

## Notebook Kit and prepared exports

- `marimo-studio/notebook-kit:default` authors Observable notebook HTML with
  native `marimo-cell`, `marimo-output`, and `mo-value` projections. The
  provider builds through Deno and Vite for Server, WebAssembly, and Prepared
  runtimes.
- Prepared exports replay committed notebook values when projection hosts mount
  after the initial render or remount after a state change.
- Every custom documentation example now publishes as a zero-Python export.
  The Room 01 monitor uses Notebook Kit and Observable Plot, including its
  prepared control states and narrow-screen chart layout.

## Lens feedback

- Lens can select authored HTML regions alongside native notebook results. Each
  custom view groups selections at `#app-shell` by default and can set a custom
  boundary with `data-marimo-lens-scope`.
- Selection feedback reconnects after a view rebuild. Parent regions own the
  visible outline while agent context retains the exact selected child.

## Installation and runtime compatibility

- `marimo-studio[recommended]` installs the Deno and Lens extras together.
- Deno 2.9.5 or newer is supported. The Lens extra requires marimo-lens 0.1.2
  or newer.
- Native editor transactions retain their configuration snapshot when the
  notebook moves during first-view creation.

Marimo Studio 0.1.6 supports Python 3.10 through 3.14 and Marimo 0.24.2.

[All changes since 0.1.5](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-studio/compare/v0.1.5...v0.1.6)
